subject: Saturday picnic, quick notes
text: Hi there, since we live close by I thought I would mention the club picnic before I forget, but please ignore if it is too much. We are meeting Saturday, I think at two, unless the rain moves it to Sunday, and the shelter is still the same place near the old playground, though I am not certain which side to enter. Bring something to share if you can, although someone said maybe only drinks, and if there are tables please take them? Anyway, if you want to come, tell me, and if the gate is locked, maybe wait, although I do not know who has the key. Sorry if confusing, I hope it works out, and if you need more detail, ask. Do not assume the old tent is up, so bring your own cover if possible. I might be late, I think.
